package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest struct {
	ProviderCode       string
	TemplateCode       string
	LanguageCode       string
	ResponseSchemaCode string
	Variables          map[string]any
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewClient interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, request PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest) (json.RawMessage, error)
}

type PracticeTaskMentorDecision struct {
	Passed   bool
	Score    *float64
	Feedback *string
}

type practiceTaskFinalValidationResult struct {
	PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID string                     `json:"practice_task_runtime_milestone_id"`
	Result                         domain.ValidationRunResult `json:"result"`
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	project, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	variant, err := selectedRuntimeVariant(runtimeContext, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	policy, configured, err := parsePracticeTaskReviewPolicy(variant.ReviewPolicyJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !configured {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: practice task revision has no final review policy", domain.ErrValidation)
	}

	milestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !allMilestonesCompleted(milestones) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: all milestones must pass before final review", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	lastMilestone, err := lastSubmittedMilestone(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, milestones)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lastAnswerID := derefString(lastMilestone.TaskAnswerID)
	if lastAnswerID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: final milestone answer is required", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	artifacts, err := useCase.Students.ListArtifacts(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifact, err := practiceTaskArtifactForAnswer(artifacts, lastAnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifactID := artifact.ID
	finalValidationResults, integrationBundlePresent, err := useCase.runPracticeTaskFinalDeterministicValidation(ctx, project, runtimeContext, variant)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	deterministicReportJSON, err := marshalDeterministicReviewReport(milestones, finalValidationResults, integrationBundlePresent)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	review := domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{
		ID:                             uuid.NewString(),
		StudentPracticeTaskID:          project.ID,
		StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: lastMilestone.ID,
		TaskAnswerID:                   lastAnswerID,
		ArtifactID:                     &artifactID,
		Status:                         domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor,
		AIStatus:                       domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusSkipped,
		AIResultJSON:                   json.RawMessage(`{}`),
		MentorStatus:                   domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPending,
		DeterministicReportJSON:        deterministicReportJSON,
		SubmittedAt:                    now,
		CreatedAt:                      now,
		UpdatedAt:                      now,
	}
	if policy.AIReview.Mode != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeDisabled {
		review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingAI
		review.AIStatus = domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusPending
	}
	saved, err := useCase.Students.CreateFinalReview(ctx, review)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview
	project.UpdatedAt = now
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if policy.AIReview.Mode == domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeDisabled {
		return saved, nil
	}
	return useCase.executePracticeTaskAIReview(ctx, project, runtimeContext, variant, policy, saved)
}

func practiceTaskArtifactForAnswer(artifacts []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact, answerID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact, error) {
	for index := range artifacts {
		var metadata struct {
			TaskAnswerID string `json:"task_answer_id"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(artifacts[index].MetaJSON, &metadata); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if metadata.TaskAnswerID == answerID && strings.TrimSpace(artifacts[index].StorageFileID) != "" {
			return &artifacts[index], nil
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: immutable submission artifact for final milestone answer is required", domain.ErrValidation)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) runPracticeTaskFinalDeterministicValidation(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
	runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext,
	variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant,
) ([]practiceTaskFinalValidationResult, bool, error) {
	if project == nil || runtimeContext == nil || useCase.Validation == nil || useCase.Sandbox == nil || project.ActiveSandboxID == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*project.ActiveSandboxID) == "" {
		return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: final deterministic validation infrastructure is unavailable", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	evaluation, err := useCase.Catalog.GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx, project.PracticeTaskRevisionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	integrationBundlePresent, err := validateVariantIntegrationEvaluationBundle(evaluation, variant.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	files, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetSnapshot(ctx, *project.ActiveSandboxID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	selectedMilestones, err := milestonesForSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, variant)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	results := make([]practiceTaskFinalValidationResult, 0, len(selectedMilestones))
	for _, milestone := range selectedMilestones {
		if !milestone.IsActive {
			continue
		}
		contract, err := parseStoredValidationContract(milestone.ValidationContractJSON)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, false, err
		}
		contractJSON, err := json.Marshal(contract)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, false, err
		}
		codeStructureTypeCode, _, err := milestoneRuntimeProfile(milestone)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, false, err
		}
		result, err := useCase.Validation.Validate(ctx, domain.ValidationRunRequest{
			TaskID:                fmt.Sprintf("practice-task-final:%s:%s", project.ID, milestone.ID),
			CodeStructureTypeCode: codeStructureTypeCode,
			Mode:                  "final",
			CodeStructure:         contractJSON,
			WorkspaceFiles:        append([]domain.WorkspaceFile(nil), files...),
			TaskMetadata: domain.ValidationTaskMetadata{
				TaskKind:       "practice_task_final_integration",
				ExecutionMode:  taskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
				EvaluationMode: taskEvaluationModeAuto,
				SubmissionMode: taskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, false, err
		}
		if result == nil || !result.Passed {
			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: final deterministic validation failed for milestone %s", domain.ErrValidation, milestone.ID)
		}
		results = append(results, practiceTaskFinalValidationResult{
			PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID: milestone.ID,
			Result:                         *result,
		})
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: final deterministic validation has no active milestones", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return results, integrationBundlePresent, nil
}

func validateVariantIntegrationEvaluationBundle(evaluation *domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, variantID string) (bool, error) {
	if evaluation == nil {
		return false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	for _, item := range evaluation.Variants {
		if item.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID != variantID {
			continue
		}
		hasAny := item.IntegrationTestSuiteRef != nil || item.IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef != nil || len(item.IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs) > 0 || item.VerificationRunnerRef != nil
		if !hasAny {
			return false, nil
		}
		if item.IntegrationTestSuiteRef == nil || item.IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef == nil || len(item.IntegrationNegativeFixtureRefs) == 0 || item.VerificationRunnerRef == nil {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("%w: incomplete private integration evaluation bundle", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		return true, nil
	}
	return false, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ListPracticeTaskFinalReviews(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	if _, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.Students.ListFinalReviews(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews(ctx context.Context, limit, offset int) ([]domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewQueueItem, error) {
	reviews, err := useCase.Students.ListPendingFinalReviews(ctx, limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	items := make([]domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewQueueItem, 0, len(reviews))
	for _, review := range reviews {
		project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, review.StudentPracticeTaskID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		task, err := useCase.buildPublicationTaskSnapshot(ctx, project)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		evaluation, err := useCase.Catalog.GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx, project.PracticeTaskRevisionID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		rubric, err := mentorRubricForVariant(evaluation, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewQueueItem{
			Review:           review,
			Project:          *project,
			Task:             task,
			MentorRubricJSON: rubric,
		})
	}
	return items, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetPracticeTaskFinalReviewForReviewer(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID, reviewID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewDetail, error) {
	if useCase.PublicationFiles == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: review artifact storage is unavailable", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	review, err := useCase.Students.GetFinalReview(ctx, reviewID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if review.StudentPracticeTaskID != studentPracticeTaskID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	task, err := useCase.buildPublicationTaskSnapshot(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	evaluation, err := useCase.Catalog.GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx, project.PracticeTaskRevisionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	rubric, err := mentorRubricForVariant(evaluation, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if review.ArtifactID == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*review.ArtifactID) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: immutable review artifact is required", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	artifacts, err := useCase.Students.ListArtifacts(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var storageFileID string
	for _, artifact := range artifacts {
		if artifact.ID == *review.ArtifactID {
			storageFileID = strings.TrimSpace(artifact.StorageFileID)
			break
		}
	}
	if storageFileID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: immutable review artifact was not found", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	archive, err := useCase.PublicationFiles.DownloadSourceArchive(ctx, storageFileID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("download review artifact: %w", err)
	}
	prepared, err := preparePublicationSnapshot(archive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewDetail{
		Review:           *review,
		Project:          *project,
		Task:             task,
		MentorRubricJSON: rubric,
		Files:            prepared.Files,
		ExcludedPaths:    prepared.SecurityReport.ExcludedPaths,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission(ctx context.Context, reviewerID, studentPracticeTaskID, reviewID string, decision PracticeTaskMentorDecision) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(reviewerID) == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if decision.Score != nil && (*decision.Score < 0 || *decision.Score > 100) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: mentor score must be between 0 and 100", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	review, err := useCase.Students.GetFinalReview(ctx, reviewID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if review.StudentPracticeTaskID != studentPracticeTaskID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor && review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusBlockedAI {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if !decision.Passed && (decision.Feedback == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*decision.Feedback) == "") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: mentor feedback is required for changes", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	review.MentorID = stringPointer(strings.TrimSpace(reviewerID))
	review.MentorFeedback = trimStringPointer(decision.Feedback)
	review.MentorScore = decision.Score
	review.ReviewedAt = &now
	review.UpdatedAt = now
	if decision.Passed {
		review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPassed
		review.MentorStatus = domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed
		project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted
		project.CompletedAt = &now
	} else {
		review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusChangesRequested
		review.MentorStatus = domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusChangesRequested
		project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusChangesRequested
		project.CompletedAt = nil
		if err := useCase.reopenReviewedMilestone(ctx, review, now); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateFinalReview(ctx, *review); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	project.UpdatedAt = now
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return review, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID, reviewID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	review, err := useCase.Students.GetFinalReview(ctx, reviewID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if review.StudentPracticeTaskID != studentPracticeTaskID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	retryableMentorFallback := review.Status == domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor &&
		review.AIStatus == domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable &&
		review.MentorStatus == domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPending
	if review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingAI &&
		review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusBlockedAI &&
		!retryableMentorFallback {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	variant, err := selectedRuntimeVariant(runtimeContext, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	policy, configured, err := parsePracticeTaskReviewPolicy(variant.ReviewPolicyJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !configured || policy.AIReview.Mode == domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeDisabled {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingAI
	review.AIStatus = domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusPending
	review.AIError = nil
	review.UpdatedAt = now
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateFinalReview(ctx, *review); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.executePracticeTaskAIReview(ctx, project, runtimeContext, variant, policy, review)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) executePracticeTaskAIReview(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
	runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext,
	variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant,
	policy domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy,
	review *domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview,
) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	contract, contractErr := useCase.loadAIReviewContract(ctx, project.PracticeTaskRevisionID, variant.ID)
	var resultJSON json.RawMessage
	var executionErr error
	if contractErr != nil {
		executionErr = contractErr
	} else if useCase.AIReview == nil {
		executionErr = fmt.Errorf("AI review service is unavailable")
	} else if project.ActiveSandboxID == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*project.ActiveSandboxID) == "" || useCase.Sandbox == nil {
		executionErr = fmt.Errorf("practice task sandbox is unavailable")
	} else {
		files, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetSnapshot(ctx, *project.ActiveSandboxID)
		if err != nil {
			executionErr = err
		} else {
			files = sanitizeWorkspaceFilesForAI(files)
			variables := map[string]any{
				"practice_task":        runtimeContext.PracticeTask,
				"solution_variant":     variant,
				"milestones":           runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones,
				"deterministic_report": json.RawMessage(review.DeterministicReportJSON),
				"workspace_files":      files,
				"review_contract":      contract,
			}
			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(variables)
			if len(encoded) > policy.AIReview.MaxInputBytes {
				executionErr = fmt.Errorf("AI review input exceeds configured byte budget")
			} else {
				resultJSON, executionErr = useCase.AIReview.Execute(ctx, PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest{
					ProviderCode:       contract.ProviderCode,
					TemplateCode:       contract.TemplateCode,
					LanguageCode:       contract.LanguageCode,
					ResponseSchemaCode: contract.ResponseSchemaCode,
					Variables:          variables,
				})
				if executionErr == nil {
					executionErr = validateAIReviewResult(resultJSON)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	review.UpdatedAt = now
	if executionErr != nil {
		review.AIStatus = domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable
		errorText := truncateReviewError(executionErr.Error())
		review.AIError = &errorText
		review.AIResultJSON = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
		if policy.AIReview.OnUnavailable == domain.PracticeTaskAIUnavailableMentorOnly {
			review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor
		} else {
			review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusBlockedAI
		}
	} else {
		review.AIStatus = domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusCompleted
		review.AIResultJSON = resultJSON
		review.AIError = nil
		review.Status = domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateFinalReview(ctx, *review); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	project.UpdatedAt = now
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return review, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadAIReviewContract(ctx context.Context, revisionID, variantID string) (domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract, error) {
	evaluation, err := useCase.Catalog.GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx, revisionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract{}, err
	}
	for _, item := range evaluation.Variants {
		if item.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID != variantID {
			continue
		}
		var contract domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract
		if err := json.Unmarshal(item.AIReviewContractJSON, &contract); err != nil {
			return domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid AI review contract", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		if contract.Version != 1 || strings.TrimSpace(contract.TemplateCode) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(contract.ResponseSchemaCode) == "" {
			return domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: incomplete AI review contract", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		return contract, nil
	}
	return domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewContract{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) reopenReviewedMilestone(ctx context.Context, review *domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, now time.Time) error {
	milestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, review.StudentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range milestones {
		if item.ID != review.StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID {
			continue
		}
		item.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed
		item.PassedAt = nil
		item.UpdatedAt = now
		if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx, item); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		break
	}
	if useCase.Answers != nil {
		answer, err := useCase.Answers.GetByID(ctx, review.TaskAnswerID)
		if err == nil && answer != nil {
			answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected
			answer.UpdatedAt = now
			if err := useCase.Answers.Update(ctx, *answer); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parsePracticeTaskReviewPolicy(raw json.RawMessage) (domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy, bool, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("{}")) {
		return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, nil
	}
	var policy domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &policy); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid review policy", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	policy.AIReview.Mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(policy.AIReview.Mode))
	policy.AIReview.OnUnavailable = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(policy.AIReview.OnUnavailable))
	policy.MentorReview.Mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(policy.MentorReview.Mode))
	if policy.Version != 1 {
		return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported review policy", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	switch policy.AIReview.Mode {
	case domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeDisabled:
	case domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeOptional, domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewModeRequired:
		if policy.AIReview.MaxInputBytes <= 0 || (policy.AIReview.OnUnavailable != domain.PracticeTaskAIUnavailableMentorOnly && policy.AIReview.OnUnavailable != domain.PracticeTaskAIUnavailableBlock) {
			return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid AI review policy", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
	default:
		return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported AI review mode", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if policy.MentorReview.Mode != domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewModeRequired {
		return domain.PracticeTaskReviewPolicy{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: review policy version 1 requires mentor review", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return policy, true, nil
}

func selectedRuntimeVariant(runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, variantID string) (domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, error) {
	for _, variant := range runtimeContext.SolutionVariants {
		if variant.ID == variantID || (variantID == "" && len(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants) == 1) {
			return variant, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func mentorRubricForVariant(evaluation *domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, variantID string) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if evaluation == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	for _, item := range evaluation.Variants {
		if item.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID == variantID {
			return append(json.RawMessage(nil), item.MentorRubricJSON...), nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func lastSubmittedMilestone(runtimeMilestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, studentMilestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, error) {
	byRuntimeID := make(map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, len(studentMilestones))
	for _, item := range studentMilestones {
		byRuntimeID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}
	sorted := domainSortRuntimeMilestones(runtimeMilestones)
	for index := len(sorted) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
		if item, ok := byRuntimeID[sorted[index].ID]; ok && item.TaskAnswerID != nil {
			copy := item
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func domainSortRuntimeMilestones(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	result := append([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone(nil), items...)
	for left := 0; left < len(result); left++ {
		for right := left + 1; right < len(result); right++ {
			if result[right].PartSortOrder < result[left].PartSortOrder || (result[right].PartSortOrder == result[left].PartSortOrder && result[right].SortOrder < result[left].SortOrder) {
				result[left], result[right] = result[right], result[left]
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}

func marshalDeterministicReviewReport(items []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, finalValidation []practiceTaskFinalValidationResult, integrationBundlePresent bool) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	reports := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		reports = append(reports, map[string]any{
			"student_milestone_id": item.ID,
			"part_milestone_id":    item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID,
			"status":               item.Status,
			"attempts_count":       item.AttemptsCount,
			"result":               json.RawMessage(item.BestResultJSON),
		})
	}
	return json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"milestones": reports,
		"final_validation": map[string]any{
			"passed":                     true,
			"integration_bundle_present": integrationBundlePresent,
			"milestones":                 finalValidation,
		},
	})
}

func validateAIReviewResult(raw json.RawMessage) error {
	var result domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &result); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid AI review result", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	result.Decision = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(result.Decision))
	if result.Decision != "pass" && result.Decision != "changes_requested" && result.Decision != "uncertain" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported AI review decision", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.Summary) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: AI review summary is required", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if result.Findings == nil || result.Evidence == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: AI review findings and evidence are required", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
		if strings.TrimSpace(finding.Category) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(finding.Message) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: AI review finding is incomplete", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		if finding.Severity != "advisory" && finding.Severity != "warning" && finding.Severity != "blocking" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: AI review finding severity is unsupported", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
	}
	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
		if strings.TrimSpace(evidence.Requirement) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(evidence.Observation) == "" || evidence.Files == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: AI review evidence is incomplete", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func stringPointer(value string) *string {
	if value == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return &value
}

func trimStringPointer(value *string) *string {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return stringPointer(strings.TrimSpace(*value))
}

func truncateReviewError(value string) string {
	const maxLength = 1000
	if len(value) <= maxLength {
		return value
	}
	return value[:maxLength]
}
